description:
Hi! We are a creative and curious team who enjoy science, technology, problem-solving, and exploring new ideas. We like working together, sharing our ideas, and turning our imagination into exciting projects.
Our team members have skills in research, building, coding, designing, presenting, and teamwork.
summary:
Earth is a dynamic and interconnected planet where changes are happening continuously. Our atmosphere, oceans, land, forests and ecosystems are all connected, and a change in one part of the Earth system can influence many others. Rising temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, melting glaciers, variations in sea levels, declining vegetation and changing ocean conditions are some of the important environmental developments that scientists are studying around the world.
Understanding these environmental changes is essential because they directly influence our natural environment, biodiversity, agriculture, water resources and the future of life on Earth. By studying historical and current environmental data, we can identify patterns, recognise unusual changes and gain a better understanding of how our planet is evolving over time. Our project, Earth Trend Detective, aims to develop an interactive, intelligent and user-friendly digital platform that uses NASA Earth observation data and scientific models to discover, analyse and visualise environmental trends across different geographical regions of the world. The main idea behind our project is to transform large and complex Earth science datasets into meaningful information that everyone can explore and understand. Instead of simply presenting numbers and scientific measurements, our tool will help users investigate environmental changes through, visual comparisons and easy-to-understand scientific explanations.
details:
A.    How the Project Works

1.     The user selects an environmental variable.

2.     The user chooses a geographical region and time period.

3.     The application retrieves the relevant Earth science data.

4.     The system processes and analyses the selected data.

5.     Statistical methods identify the direction and strength of the trend.

6.     Interactive graphs and maps display the results.

7.     The application generates a simple explanation of the environmental changes.

B. Innovation and Uniqueness

The innovative aspect of Earth Trend Detective is its ability to bring environmental data selection, geographical comparison, trend analysis and statistical interpretation together in one user-friendly platform.

Instead of simply displaying environmental data, the application helps users investigate patterns and understand how environmental changes differ across geographical regions.

It aims to make complex scientific information accessible to people without advanced scientific or statistical knowledge.

C. Expected Impact

Our project aims to:

  • Improve awareness of environmental and climate-related changes.
  • Make NASA Earth science data easier to explore.
  • Help students understand real-world environmental science.
  • Support scientific exploration and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Encourage people to become active explorers and protectors of our planet.
